data.body: **P1 — The runner contract omits the required `runner` account.** Model workflows still use `Defaults:runner`, assign files and workspaces to `runner:runner`, and assume `/home/runner`. A root-capable CodeBuild or self-hosted runner using another agent account can therefore fail during setup or credential/output handoff despite satisfying these documented requirements. Derive the invoking user, group, and home dynamically and test a non-`runner` image, or explicitly require a Linux runner provisioned with the `runner` account and home.
